card.name: YouTube link symbols and author initials
card.fires_on: The ?v or = in YouTube watch URLs just before the random video ID. Also a surname or hex-color # inside reference lists and color codes, where a short capital-letter code comes next.

modes.label: YouTube URL
modes.description: The ?v or = right before the video ID in a youtube.com/watch link.

modes.label: Author names in citations
modes.description: A surname in a reference author list, where an initial letter comes next.
modes.example: Cutler C,<< Lee>> S, Greenberg P, et al

modes.label: Hex color code
modes.description: The # before a hex color value.

card.writes: It promotes short repeated capital-letter strings like GG, RR and PJ, which fit initials or codes.
card.plain: It fires at spots where a string of random letters or an initial comes next, like a video link ID or an author's initials.
